description: Web search API for AI agents — find current information, news, documentation, competitors, prices or any fact that needs a fresh, citable source. Pay-per-call, no API key. Returns ranked results with title, URL, snippet, publish date and source from neural + keyword search over the live web, with automatic provider failover. Use when an agent asks: search the web, look up the latest on a topic, find sources or links. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: agentbit.web_search
title: Web Search
